verdict.rationale: CSC's entity management product claims built-in AI for document work: bulk imports, automated entity and folder routing, and instant summaries of key content. That is product-native AI handling narrow tasks for the user, but nothing shows an interactive assistant you can hand open-ended tasks to. missing for 10: a documented conversational or agentic AI assistant, delegation of tasks beyond document routing and summarization, in-depth docs on the AI feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
